description: This Java class defines a strategy that handles the ThingDefinitionCreated event within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It extends an abstract event strategy class and implements logic to update a ThingBuilder based on the event data.

classes.name: ThingDefinitionCreatedStrategy
classes.description: A final class implementing a strategy to process ThingDefinitionCreated events, updating the ThingBuilder accordingly.

methods.name: applyEvent
methods.description: Applies a ThingDefinitionCreated event to a ThingBuilder, setting the definition based on the event data.
